title: Mom said no
subtitle: Mummy ne mana kar diya!
text: Your mom refused permission for the later dates. Your latest available date range has been cancelled.

title: Mom said yes, at the last minute!
subtitle: Mummy maan gayi!
text: Good news! Your mom gave permission. A previously blocked date range has now opened up for you.

title: Mom's condition
subtitle: Sunday 8 baje tak ghar wapis!
text: Mom's strict rule: You must be back home by Sunday 8 PM and no overnight buses or trains allowed.

title: Dad wants to know every detail
subtitle: Papa is asking: 'Kaha jaa rahe ho sab?'
text: Dad needs the exact destination name aloud within 30 seconds, or the group loses 10 seconds of planning time!

title: Relative's engagement or wedding
subtitle: Shaadi ka invitation aa gaya!
text: A mandatory cousin's wedding ceremony just landed on one of your weekends. That weekend is now blocked for you.

title: Parents are calling
subtitle: Ghar se phone aa raha hai, chup raho!
text: Your parents are calling your phone! You must stay completely silent and cannot speak or type for the next 20 seconds.

title: Sudden work trip
subtitle: Client visit aa gayi!
text: Your manager assigned you an urgent on-site visit. One of your date windows is no longer available.

title: Boss cancelled your leave
subtitle: Leave reject ho gayi!
text: Your manager rejected your leave application! You cannot take any weekdays off (strictly weekend only).

title: Internal exams or deadline
subtitle: Exam time table release ho gaya!
text: College internal submissions announced! You can strictly only travel on Friday-to-Sunday weekends from now on.

title: Client meeting moved
subtitle: Monday subah meeting hai!
text: Important client presentation moved to Monday 9 AM sharp. You must return by Sunday evening.

title: Festival season surge
subtitle: Diwali / Festive surge pricing!
text: Hotel and ticket prices jumped 25%! Computed trip budgets for all destinations are now 25% higher.

title: Tatkal tickets are gone
subtitle: Tatkal waitlist 150 ho gayi!
text: All train Tatkal tickets sold out in 30 seconds! Rail travel now requires indirect routes adding 6 hours travel time.

title: Petrol prices jumped
subtitle: Petrol mehenga ho gaya!
text: Fuel prices just hiked! Road trip car rentals and cabs will cost 15% more per person.

title: Someone forgot to pay their share last time
subtitle: Purana hisaab baaki hai!
text: You remembered your friend never paid for the last trip. Your personal budget ceiling drops by 10%.

title: Free Wi-Fi hotel deal
subtitle: Mast coupon code mil gaya!
text: Relief twist! A member found an online promo code reducing accommodation expenses by 10% for the group.

title: Two friends had a fight
subtitle: Kalesh ho gaya!
text: Two players had an ego clash! -10 seconds on the timer. For the next 25 seconds, they cannot speak to each other directly.

title: Someone's cousin is tagging along
subtitle: Sharma ji ka beta bhi aayega!
text: An extra cousin is joining the group last minute! Group size increases by 1, rearranging room sharing and travel split.

title: Someone is bringing their partner
subtitle: Plus one entry!
text: One friend is bringing their partner! The group must pick accommodation with proper private room availability.

title: A friend wants to cancel
subtitle: Bhai mera mann nahi kar raha!
text: One friend is backing out! Group has 20 seconds on the clock to convince them. -10s if the group cannot quickly align.

title: Group photo ruckus
subtitle: Ek achhi photo toh khinch lo pehle!
text: Comic relief: Everyone stops arguing to take a group selfie. -5 seconds as everyone poses for 'one more angle'.

title: Monsoon alert
subtitle: Heavy rainfall warning!
text: Weather bureau issues a monsoon rain alert. Mountain roads have landslide risk and beach swimming is prohibited.

title: Heatwave advisory
subtitle: Bohot garmi hai baahar!
text: Extreme temperatures reported! Destinations tagged as 'hot' climate are banned for participants with heat sensitivity.

title: Train delayed by 4 hours
subtitle: Gaadi 4 ghante late chal rahi hai!
text: Signal failure causes major railway delays. All train options now add 4 extra hours of travel time.

title: Passport or ID issue
subtitle: Passport expire ho gaya!
text: You realized your passport is expired or Aadhaar is mismatched! You cannot travel on any International destination.
